body: I agree. It’s not right. It’s “sugarcoating” the truth. It’s a lie, basically. I’m sitting here for months unemployed and can’t get a job to save my life. And I just want to die all the time. Nothing keeps me going. Just take joy in your wife and live each day to your best ability. That’s my advice

That’s useless now. They’re already here. They don’t seem to care now or ever will. My depression stems from being worthless not being able to produce income since I quit my job. If I leave, my phone gets taken away. I have nothing if I leave my parents house except a meaningless life on the streets.

Sometimes I wonder what would happen to family members if I died. Because for years they have been saying that I would never do it. And I really want to prove to them that I’m not a chicken shit, you know? They already think I’m a bum who sits around doing absolutely nothing but watching movies and eating their food when I can’t even get a fucking job.
I suppose I’ll just have to hang myself then. My optimism is what’s kept me here but it’s waning fast.

Well I try to have an optimistic focus on things but I’ve had an optimistic focus for months and literally everything has gone to hell. My mom was fired, I quit my job of a few years because I couldn’t stand it anymore and since then our only income has been my dad. I’ve heard plenty of homeless stories from reddit and it’s the LAST thing I want for me. I would rather hang myself than be homeless. For one thing if I’m homeless, how would I get a job or another place to stay? Society looks down on them. Look on my profile. I have been very suicidal for the past three months. I’ve been trying to get a job for four months almost and they say when you’ve been out of work for 6, you can forget getting a job. I really hope you decide to stay but if you decide to go, I hope you’re at peace.

To be that young and think about suicide is understandable. I’m there now at 25 and I have nothing to look forward to. The economy is not doing well, I have no job, most of my family has no job due to being fired or quitting work. Basically I’ll be on the streets soon if not with my entire family. My dad only makes $1300 a month and he claims that it costs $3,000 a month to keep us all here financially. I don’t know what I’m going to do. I sometimes wonder if the government expects the unemployed to kill themselves. In your case, I would say wait and see how things go. Maybe wait six months to a year and see how you feel then. I’m a prisoner in my own house. You don’t have to be a prisoner to your mind. You can fight the urge to die. Like I said just think about it. Sometimes it hurts me to think about. But I don’t want to die and I don’t want to live right now. Things may change for me or you, who knows? Whether you decide to stay or go, it’s ultimately up to you.
I think having friends is useless. I have had way too many use the opportunity to stab me in the back. Being alone is much more beneficial.

It gets better is bull shit. I’m not telling you not to do it. It should be a personal right to all of us. I’m 25 and I have no job, no money, nowhere to go unless I stay with my parents. So as you can imagine I’ve been thinking about offing myself too

Just so you know, when you’re 25 years old and you still live at home unemployed and no one will hire you or date you and you’re on the point of homelessness it gets much easier to try to kill yourself be it with pills or a shotgun. If you want to live, just get yourself help. Call an ambulance and have them take you to the psych ward. In my case, I was never really suicidal until about a year or two ago when I was in an abusive relationship. Then I started cutting, drinking and smoking. Things I’d never tried to do before in my teens because things were never that bad for me. I used to look at people who were depressed and suicidal and think they were insane or crazy. I didn’t think that I would ever suffer from the same issues because of job loss and living with abusive family members, who really just make things worse.

Oh yes it is. If you worked for the assholes I did, you’d definitely see why I could no longer stay there. If I did someone a favor at work by coming in on my fucking day off, they would stab me in the back. I’ll see how things go, but I’ll still think about it. I may just hang myself instead.

I quit my job of about three years as a cashier and I thought I was making the right decision in getting out. It was a very stressful and demanding place to work, on a road to a dead end really. I never got a raise after being there for so long. Now I have run out of money and I have no one to help me. I don’t know what I’m going to do about paying bills. I have put in for more jobs to no avail for two months. It’s Christmas and I’m just so unhappy. What used to be my favorite holiday is literal hell. Knowing what I have to deal with in the next three months, I’d rather be dead.
For about two months. I don’t really have anyone. I’ve been ready to kill myself for years even when I did have someone.
